Drop the views a build left nearly empty

Source: R/atlas_views.R
atlas_view_remove_sparse.Rd

Slabs tile the bounding box of an atlas's labels, so a slab can land where almost none of the structures are and come back holding a region or two against a full anatomical backdrop. This drops those views, counting what each one actually holds rather than naming the views to remove.

Usage

atlas_view_remove_sparse(atlas, min_regions = 5)

Arguments

atlas

A ggseg_atlas object with 2D geometry.

min_regions

Smallest number of drawn regions a view may hold and still be kept. A view with fewer is dropped.

Value

The ggseg_atlas, in the representation it arrived in.

Details

Count, do not name. A build script that names the views to drop goes stale silently: rename a slab or lay the slabs out again and the pattern matches nothing, the panel survives, and the only sign is a thin view in the finished atlas. Counting degrades to dropping nothing instead.

Context does not count. A view showing nothing but the grey brain is the case this exists to remove, so only labels that are drawn as regions are counted; see ggseg.formats::atlas_context().

Run this after the regions have been removed, not before. A slab full of ventricles looks well populated to the builder and renders empty once ggseg.formats::atlas_region_remove() has taken the ventricles out. The pipeline already discards slabs that no labelled voxel falls into, which is the same policy at a threshold of zero, applied to the volume before anything is traced.

See also

ggseg.formats::atlas_view_remove() to drop views by name, and ggseg.formats::atlas_view_remove_small() to drop slivers within a view rather than the view itself.

Other atlas geometry: atlas_dilate(), atlas_polish(), atlas_simplify(), atlas_smooth(), atlas_view_region_counts(), count_vertices()

Examples

aseg <- ggseg.formats::aseg()

# How many regions each view is carrying
atlas_view_region_counts(aseg)
#>       axial_2     coronal_2 sagittal_left 
#>            29            26            20 

atlas_view_remove_sparse(aseg, min_regions = 5)
#> 
#> ── aseg ggseg atlas ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> Type: subcortical
#> Regions: 18
#> Hemispheres: left, midline, right
#> Views: axial_2, coronal_2, sagittal_left
#> Palette: ✔
#> Rendering: ✔ ggseg
#> ✔ ggseg3d (meshes)

#>       hemi            region                  label              display
#> 1     left cerebellum cortex Left-Cerebellum-Cortex    cerebellum cortex
#> 2     left          thalamus          Left-Thalamus             thalamus
#> 3     left           caudate           Left-Caudate              caudate
#> 4     left           putamen           Left-Putamen              putamen
#> 5     left          pallidum          Left-Pallidum             pallidum
#> 6  midline        brain stem             Brain-Stem           brain stem
#> 7     left       hippocampus       Left-Hippocampus          hippocampus
#> 8     left          amygdala          Left-Amygdala             amygdala
#> 9     left    accumbens area    Left-Accumbens-area            accumbens
#> 10    left         ventraldc         Left-VentralDC ventral diencephalon
#>        structure
#> 1     cerebellum
#> 2  basal ganglia
#> 3  basal ganglia
